tool: Built-in image_gen, reference generation followed by multiscale-relief refinement
user_direction: Retain approximate accepted art style. Replace ordinary flat valley direction with nested worlds across growth scales, ultimately bacteria to cosmos; terrain should use fractal heightmap rules with relief at different scales.
visual_focus: Continuous nested ridges, basins and branching channels, from foreground moss micro-landscape to local valley to regional mountains. Warm matte stylized 3D appearance.
scope: This is an aspirational terrain concept for the revised design, superseding the previous fixed-valley composition as a visual exploration. It is not the current map, a generated numerical heightmap, or proof of mathematical self-similarity. Cosmic and microbial gameplay remain future scope.
qa: Inspected initial and refined output. Refinement adds relief within previously flat plateau tops and more legible foreground miniature basins. No HUD, text or panel collage. True metric scale, traversal, biome transitions and runtime LOD must be validated in 3D.
files_modified: Only new concept deliverables. Existing concept and game source preserved.
